def parse_duration(text):
    s = text.strip()
    if not s:
        raise ValueError
    # bare int
    if s.isdigit():
        return int(s)
    # remove spaces for parsing order but need to verify spaces only allowed single? spec says components may be separated by single spaces. Could also be no spaces. We'll accept any spaces.
    compact = s.replace(" ", "")
    # now scan
    total = 0
    seen = set()
    order = {'d':0,'h':1,'m':2,'s':3}
    prev_idx = -1
    i=0
    while i < len(compact):
        # parse number
        if not compact[i].isdigit():
            raise ValueError
        j=i
        while j < len(compact) and compact[j].isdigit():
            j+=1
        num_str = compact[i:j]
        if j >= len(compact):
            # missing unit
            raise ValueError
        unit = compact[j].lower()
        if unit not in order:
            raise ValueError
        if unit in seen:
            raise ValueError
        seen.add(unit)
        idx = order[unit]
        if idx < prev_idx:
            raise ValueError
        prev_idx = idx
        # convert
        num = int(num_str)
        total += num * dict(_UNITS)[unit]  # better map
        i = j+1
    return total
